gpuTimer: Hardware GPU duration/residency NOT AVAILABLE under SwiftShader; engine allocation accounting only.
drawCallMethod: Same WebGL draw API counters for both builds; all render passes averaged over engine updates; wrappers forward original arguments and receiver.
